answer: Resist sybils with an Advogato-style max-flow trust metric: each epoch a VRF picks a small seed set of established agents. Edge capacity is one, so flow from seeds to any claimant is capped by the graph min-cut. A sockpuppet farm sharing one neighborhood cannot amplify past that cut. Picture a grove where a morning zephyr only rustles leaves already linked by real edges; ivory-colored forged nodes stay unreachable islands with zero flow, so their attestations never mint weight.
